a:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16-bit pickleball game head sprite sheet.
Use BOTH attached images as references: guide_head_cell.png shows head geometry, fixed hat dome, neck anchor, female hanging ponytail and hat compatibility; guide_cell_plain.png gives the exact cell layout. Generate only bare heads, no hats, guide marks, body, shirt or collar.
Match the attached guide's chunky pixel art: 1 art-pixel dark outline, flat colour clusters, light from top left, skin shaded in four tones, darkest at back of jaw and under chin. HD remaster players are about 96 art pixels tall; each head about 24 x 30 art pixels. Expressive eye, brow and mouth, long forward chin, goofy lovable slightly ugly look, never generic cute or anime.
Image exactly 1920 x 384, five 384 x 384 cells side by side. Each cell is 48 x 48 art pixels enlarged 8x, one art pixel an aligned 8 x 8 block. Exactly ONE right-facing PROFILE head in each cell, one eye visible, same position and scale as plain guide. Cranium centre at art (23,24), fixed hat dome radius about (11.4,10.6), band y=21. Top and back skull fill this dome; hair above band stays close to skull, no tall hair, buns, spikes or quiffs. Face/jaw/chin/nose/eye/brow/mouth/ear/facial hair may vary in front of and below band. Stay within each cell leaving room in front for brim (12 art px forward of forehead). Neck joins at (22,44), no shirt/collar or anything below neck. Female hanging ponytail tied just behind dome at band y=21, like guide's second panel.
Transparent background. Exactly these nine opaque colours, flat with no anti-aliasing: outline #181424, white #ffffff, skin deep-to-light #8c4834 #c06e4c #eea272 #fccc9e, hair deep-to-light #382016 #663c22 #965e34. Facial hair/brows/lashes use hair colours; freckles/wrinkles/stubble use two darker skin colours; glasses outline and white. No text, letters, digits, logos, labels, dividers or grid.

Five men's heads left to right: (1) guide's own head redrawn cleaner: same long chin and short hair, eye with white and dark pupil, brow with attitude, mouth with a corner; (2) lantern jaw square and heavy, chin pushed even further forward, shadow of stubble; (3) big hooked nose, smaller chin slopes back, bushy brows; (4) older bald man, skin crown still filling fixed dome, fringe of hair at back, wrinkles at eye, droopy nose and bigger ear; (5) walrus moustache hiding mouth with long chin under it.
